summary: Second exact-head review clears the original four blockers but finds three bounded P2 issues: unbounded server retry hints, non-cancelable per-installation gate waits, and configurable mandatory-permission elevation.
validation: Focused tests, race tests, vet, and diff checks pass for the reviewed head
blockers: Retry-After/X-RateLimit-Reset hints can cause indefinite sleep when the caller has no deadline.
A canceled caller can wait indefinitely on the per-installation exchange mutex.
RequiredPermissions configuration can elevate a mandatory permission level and have that elevation accepted.
next_action: Return to code for bounded retry delay, context-aware exchange gating, and rejection of mandatory-permission elevation, then repeat independent review and hosted validation.

issues.title: Bound server retry hints explicitly
issues.details: Return a bounded retryable error when a server hint exceeds the configured maximum instead of sleeping indefinitely.

issues.title: Make installation exchange gate context-aware
issues.details: Canceled callers must not wait behind a stalled per-installation exchange.

issues.title: Reject mandatory permission elevation in overrides
issues.details: Custom required-permission config may extend but cannot raise mandatory levels.
